generations.text: Nadia Petrov contacted support because the Volt Charger has a loose cable latch since 2026-01-10. It is a High priority case and the status is currently Working. The agent offered a replacement of $240.00. The customer was told a firmware update would arrive on 2026-01-24. The customer confirmed order ORD-85312 and asked for a callback. The knowledge base notes that Volt Charger units are exchanged within 18 months for latch faults.
